name: zinc finger protein 649

function.text: ZNF649 is the approved symbol for zinc finger protein 649. Reviewed functional annotations implicate its product in DNA-binding transcription factor activity; RNA polymerase II cis-regulatory region sequence-specific DNA binding; regulation of transcription by RNA polymerase II.

germline.text: No conflict-free strong or definitive constitutional disease relationship met the source-selection criteria for this draft; this does not exclude a germline association.

somatic.text: Cancer Hotspots v1 reports recurrent residue-level observations in Colorectal carcinoma; Pancreatic adenocarcinoma; Gastric adenocarcinoma. This is statistical recurrence evidence; it does not establish that every variant in this gene is a driver or a clinically actionable alteration. Evidence in this collection is restricted to the historical V1 release.

somatic_associations.mechanism: Historical hotspot cohort observation; individual-allele significance and tumor-specific oncogenicity require review.

function.text: ZNF649 encodes zinc finger protein 649. Its functions include DNA-binding transcription factor activity and RNA polymerase II cis-regulatory region sequence-specific DNA binding.

somatic.text: Somatic alterations involving ZNF649 have been reported in colorectal carcinoma, endometrial carcinoma, and gastric adenocarcinoma.
